title: Client Gift Delivery
scenario: A sender asks for employee home addresses to send client gifts.

answers.A: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.B: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.C: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.
answers.D: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.

explanation: Client Gift Delivery: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Personal address collection needs HR/legal-approved process.
